# <span id="aanchor78"></span> Data Stream Editor

The Data Stream Editor serves as a reference for data collection (SCADA). The information on this screen displays on the Misc. tab of the Meter Editor. This data is informational only and does not trigger any other functionality.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Data Stream Editor and create a new data stream:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.

2.  Select **Data Stream** within the **Application** group.

    The Data Stream Editor is also available from the General tab of the Gas or Liquid Quality Source Editor.

3.  Click the **New** button to create a new data stream.

4.  Enter the code and name at the bottom of the screen. Both of these fields are alphanumeric. Click the **Auto Generate Code** button to automatically increment the current largest code number by 1.

5.  Click the **Save** button.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 549;height: 281;" />

Data streams cannot be deleted once they are saved.

</div>
